mapper.select: SELECT PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, NVL(CATEGORY, '미분류') AS CATEGORY, FN_FORMAT_AMOUNT(UNIT_PRICE) AS UNIT_PRICE, WEIGHT, UTL_RAW.CAST_TO_VARCHAR2(PRODUCT_CODE) AS PRODUCT_CODE_STR, NVL(DESCRIPTION, '설명 없음') AS DESCRIPTION, DECODE(IS_ACTIVE, 1, '판매중', 0, '판매중지', '알수없음') AS STATUS, TO_CHAR(CREATED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_DATE FROM PRODUCTS WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}

SELECT DECODE(CATEGORY, 'ELEC', '전자제품', 'FOOD', '식품', 'CLOTH', '의류', 'BOOK', '도서', '기타') AS CATEGORY_NM, CATEGORY, COUNT(*) AS PRODUCT_COUNT, FN_FORMAT_AMOUNT(ROUND(AVG(UNIT_PRICE), 0)) AS AVG_PRICE, FN_FORMAT_AMOUNT(MIN(UNIT_PRICE)) AS MIN_PRICE, FN_FORMAT_AMOUNT(MAX(UNIT_PRICE)) AS MAX_PRICE, ROUND(SQRT(VARIANCE(UNIT_PRICE)), 2) AS PRICE_STDDEV FROM PRODUCTS WHERE IS_ACTIVE = 1 GROUP BY CATEGORY HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1 ORDER BY PRODUCT_COUNT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCTS ( PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, CATEGORY, UNIT_PRICE, WEIGHT, PRODUCT_CODE, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE, CREATED_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_PRODUCT.NEXTVAL, #{productName}, #{category}, #{unitPrice}, #{weight}, UTL_RAW.CAST_TO_RAW(#{productCode}), #{description}, NVL(#{isActive}, 1), SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCTS SET UNIT_PRICE = GREATEST( ROUND(UNIT_PRICE * (1 + #{changeRate} / 100), 0), 100 ) WHERE CATEGORY = #{category} AND IS_ACTIVE = 1
mapper.select: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.CATEGORY, COALESCE(S.TOTAL_QTY, 0) AS TOTAL_QTY, FN_FORMAT_AMOUNT(COALESCE(S.TOTAL_REVENUE, 0)) AS TOTAL_REVENUE, COALESCE(S.ORDER_CNT, 0) AS ORDER_COUNT, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(S.TOTAL_REVENUE, 0) DESC) AS QUARTILE, CASE NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(S.TOTAL_REVENUE, 0) DESC) WHEN 1 THEN 'A등급' WHEN 2 THEN 'B등급' WHEN 3 THEN 'C등급' ELSE 'D등급' END AS GRADE FROM PRODUCTS P LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID, SUM(QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_QTY, SUM(QUANTITY * UNIT_PRICE - NVL(DISCOUNT_AMT, 0)) AS TOTAL_REVENUE, COUNT(DISTINCT ORDER_ID) AS ORDER_CNT FROM ORDER_ITEMS GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID ) S ON P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID WHERE P.IS_ACTIVE = 1 ORDER BY COALESCE(S.TOTAL_REVENUE, 0) DESC
SELECT CODE_VALUE, CODE_NAME, NVL(DESCRIPTION, '') AS DESCRIPTION, SORT_ORDER FROM CODE_MASTER WHERE CODE_GROUP = #{codeGroup} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORDER, CODE_VALUE
